plan.title: fix(installer): hybrid update/setup must deposit root git hooks

narratives.Description: Hybrid deposits can lack project-root .githooks/; task setup only sets core.hooksPath and update skips writeConsumerGitHooks even on alreadyCurrent. Consumers end up with a nonfunctional hooksPath and verify:hooks-installed fails with no self-heal path.
narratives.Overview: Hybrid deposits can lack project-root .githooks/; setup only sets core.hooksPath; update skips writeConsumerGitHooks. Follow maintainer recommended fix on the issue comment: call writeConsumerGitHooks from runRefreshDeposit (incl. alreadyCurrent), transactional setup, docs + regression.
narratives.UserStory: As a hybrid consumer missing root githooks, I want directive update to deposit hooks and setup to refuse pointing Git at a missing directory, so that verify hooks-installed can pass after a supported repair flow.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. packages/core/src/init-deposit/refresh.ts: call writeConsumerGitHooks from runRefreshDeposit including alreadyCurrent path (#2595-style).
2. Make setup/deft:setup transactional: deposit hooks or refuse hooksPath when files missing.
3. Align content/UPGRADING.md and verify:hooks-installed recovery prose.
4. Regression test for already-current hybrid + missing root hooks. Closes #2530.
narratives.Acceptance: Update deposits root hooks even when payload current; setup never configures missing hooks dir; verify:hooks-installed passes after supported flow; docs accurate; regression test green.

items.title: update always-repair root hooks via writeConsumerGitHooks

narrative.Acceptance: Given already-current hybrid deposit with missing project-root .githooks/, when runRefreshDeposit runs, then pre-commit/pre-push/_deft-run.sh are deposited and hooksPath is correctly set.
Given missing project-root .githooks files, when task setup / deft:setup runs, then it either deposits hooks first or refuses to set core.hooksPath=.githooks.
Given UPGRADING.md and verify:hooks-installed recovery text, when an agent reads them, then they name update as the heal path and do not claim setup alone deposits hooks.
Given a fixture with already-current payload and absent root hooks, when the refresh suite runs, then hooks are repaired.

references.title: Issue #2530: hybrid setup does not deposit root git hooks

expected_outputs: setup fail-safe for missing hooks dir
